issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents: the problem statement contains a contradiction. The textual task description (problem_statement.md lines 43-45) says the method should "return a String of the following format LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)", and the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 80) defines the method as public String getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(). However the UML diagram in the problem statement (problem_statement.md line 71) declares the method as returning void (+getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): void). This mismatch between the UML and both the textual description and the reference implementation will confuse students about the expected return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the problem statement consistent: update the UML diagram entry for getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents to return String (change '+getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): void' to '+getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String') so it matches the textual description and the reference implementation. Alternatively, if a void return was intended, change the textual task description and the reference implementation accordingly and update any tests.
